crossRefs.note: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel…
Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her…
Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be…

translations.web: When the king’s decree which he shall make is published throughout all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give their husbands honor, both great and small.”
translations.bsb: The edict the king issues will be heard throughout his vast kingdom—and so all women, from the least to the greatest, will honor their husbands.”
translations.kjv: And when the king's decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire, (for it is great,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.
translations.asv: And when the king's decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give to their husbands honor, both to great and small.
